anchors.anchor_stand: floor pad centre of the stand-in cockpit (operator feet), child of body; face +Z

sides: L/R = vehicle's own left/right: L = +X, R = -X
hierarchy: reach_truck > body > {beacon, wheel_LL, wheel_LR, steer_drive > wheel_drive, caster > wheel_caster, reach > {reach_base, mast_outer > mast_inner > fork_carriage}}

rig.drive: move/rotate root; fixed axle = load wheels in the baselegs (z +0.90 m glTF); the single drive wheel (x=-0.25, z=-0.75 glTF) steers
rig.steer: rotate steer_drive about local Y, +-90 deg (reach trucks turn on the spot)
rig.spin: rotate wheel_* about local X; drive r=0.17, load wheels r=0.11, caster r=0.09
rig.reach: translate reach along local +Z (glTF) 0..0.60 m: the whole mast rolls forward along the baseleg rails
rig.lift: two-stage: fork_carriage +Y 0..1.30 m (free lift), then mast_inner +Y 0..1.85 m; max fork height 3.15 m above rest. carriage top 0.62 + free lift 1.30 = 1.92 < inner rail top 2.41; inner stage keeps 0.51 m overlap in the outer rails at full extension
rig.caster: caster yoke may swivel freely about Y (cosmetic)

nodes.body: chassis, operator compartment (stand-in, open to the vehicle-left side), overhead guard 2.26 m, baselegs
nodes.reach: Empty at the mast foot on the rails (x=0, y=0.36, z=+0.12 glTF); translate +Z to reach
nodes.reach_base: reach carriage plate + rollers (child of reach)
nodes.mast_outer: outer uprights 2.45 m, child of reach
nodes.fork_carriage: carriage + backrest + 2 forks 1.07 x 0.10 x 0.045 m, tapered tips; translate +Y
nodes.steer_drive: drive-wheel yoke; origin at the axle centre (steer axis is vertical through it)
nodes.wheel_drive/wheel_LL/wheel_LR/wheel_cast: origin exactly at axle centre; spin about local X
nodes.caster: caster yoke, origin at axle centre
